name: Lån & Spar Invest - Globale Aktier Basis Akkumulerende
summary: Lån & Spar Invest - Globale Aktier Basis Akkumulerende is a Danish investment fund that invests in a diversified portfolio of global equities and reinvests dividends to enhance capital appreciation. The fund is managed by Lån & Spar Invest. The fund is based in Denmark.
